idea: An online shop for restored vintage road bikes, around €450 each

brand.name: Segunda Vuelta
brand.voice: Precise, honest, nerdy, calm. Write like a mechanic's notebook.

candidates.construction: Ink disc r26 centred at 32,32. Background-coloured quarter-turn cut: right half is a second disc offset. Accent bar crosses the seam as a small rect, the weld joint.
candidates.idea: A wheel turned over: half worn, half renewed, with one red repair seam.

candidates.construction: Ink square 52 with a circle r16 cut out in paper at centre; accent inspection arc slice: quarter disc in the cut-out's upper right, like a magnifier window onto the metal.
candidates.idea: A frame tube cross-section with a red spot showing the inside checked for rust.

candidates.construction: S from two half-ring arcs, stroke 10 on r10 centres at 32,20 and 32,44 joined, with an accent quarter disc as the terminal at the lower left.
candidates.idea: An S made of two wheel arcs, one red: the second turn.

candidates.construction: S from two ink quarter-disc blocks diagonally opposed, 26 units each, meeting at centre; paper diagonal cut between, an accent bar crossing the middle like a tube.
candidates.idea: A blocky S of two quarter wheels joined by a red steel tube.

candidates.construction: Ink circle r26 with a paper circle r14 offset to the right-hand side, leaving a crescent; accent small circle r6 sits inside the cut as the second turn.
candidates.idea: A worn crescent with a fresh red wheel inside: a second round.
